Figure 13.Cutting modules for the 300 k Montefibre precursor based TCF designed for 5 tow feeds 13 Units note: Mix ratios can be expressed by weight, by volume, or PHR (parts per hundred). Due to differences in density between resins and catalysts the ratio by weight and the ratio by volume will be different in many cases. The most common expressions for materials that are to be mixed by hand are by weight or PHR (PHR is also a measurement by weight). When this is the case, the correct amounts of resin and catalyst are measured out on a scale and mixed together Arotran 774/775 resin system was used for the SMC trials. The composition of the resin and the additives is shown in Table 2. Arotran 774 in 70 wt% and 775 in 30 wt% along with additives included TBPB, styrene, zinc stearate and Huber A-4 in 195 g of calcium to give a 302 PHR A- side paste of specific gravity 1 g/cc. Total B-side PHR is 1.00. A total SMC paste PHR of 303 for A + B side was obtained. INDCO 5-gallon mixing machine was used for mixing the resin and the ingredients, see Figure 14. Also the rheology equipment was installed to aid in the study of resin systems and their performance. After mixing, rheology was measured using Gel Timer Brookfield AMETEK DV2T viscometer to establish consistency for each mixed system. The Brookfield viscometer measures gel time using unique magnetic coupling that attaches the glass rod to instrument. When gel time is reached, display shows both gel time and equivalent viscosity value. The glass rod is quickly and easily detached from instrument. An integrated temperature probe provides peak exotherm data. An existing oven was converted for use as a low temperature (<150F) maturation oven for the produced SMC.
